name: outcome-shopping-template
description: Multi-vendor, outcome-based shopping with Workers AI. Decomposes a shopper's intent into component needs, then composes a cross-merchant recommendation from each merchant's /llms.txt catalog.

MERCHANT_ENDPOINTS.description: JSON array of registered merchant endpoints — each item is `{"name":"...","url":"https://..."}`. Each merchant is expected to serve `/api/products` in the shape emitted by the [commerce-llms-txt-template](https://github.com/cloudflare/templates/tree/main/commerce-llms-txt-template). Leave as the default to use the bundled sample catalog.

AI_MODEL.description: Workers AI model ID used for intent decomposition and per-need matching (default: `@cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it`).

CACHE_TTL.description: How long aggregated merchant catalogs are cached in seconds (default: 300).
